[ S. bubhukṣita], wishing to eat; hungry; Abh 756 (chāto c’ eva ~o); Ja II 14, 4* (~o no visahāmi bhottuṃ); V 72, 16´ (~o ti sañjātabubhukkho chātajjhatto); Mil 66, 12 (yadā tvaṃ ~o bhaveyyāsi tadā tvaṃ khettaṃ kasāpeyyāsi …); Pv-a 72, 22 (chātan ti ~aṃ khudāya abhibhūtaṃ); Dāṭh 3:32 (saso … dvijāya yo dajji dehaṃ … ~āya).
